title: Kagamine Rin — Mystery Path Discovered?!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You did so well during practice today, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm...?
You look concerned. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka!
It's nothing all that serious...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I didn't decide what I was gonna do after we finished practicing singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, why don't you use this time to relax? I'm sure you're tired since you made such a big effort during practice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shizuku and the others also said they don't have work today. I think it's important to take breaks when you can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know that's important...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But still...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm having trouble staying still after singing and dancing so much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I know the feeling. It's hard not to want to practice more when you're having fun and in good condition.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But we had a fairly hard practice today, no?
What if all the fatigue from today hits you tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If I don't find something to do, then I'm just gonna keep practicing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
Then, why don't we go for a walk together?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but we'd really just be walking around all the stages...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
Has that path always been there?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, look at that...!
Where do you think it goes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wanna go check it out, Luka?
We should totally take a look!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You said you'd go on a walk with me, right? So, let's go♪
se_run_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. She sure is full of energy today.

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Luka! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Coming♪
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
When do you think this path appeared?!
What if it's a shortcut to another stage♪
se_run_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What is this place?!
Luka! Come quick!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's good that the MORE MORE HOUSE is coming along so nicely.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm looking forward to the girls doing their first stream...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO, look at this...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wh-What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Luka! Come quick!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Wh-What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm...?
That sounded like Rin and MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Did something happen?
Maybe I should try heading over to where they are.
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This place wasn't always here, right, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: N-No way! We would've noticed since we're always using at least one of the stages.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right, which means... This is a newly created area.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Doesn't that make this a huge discovery?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, it does!
We've stumbled upon something massive♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow...! This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, more importantly! We gotta go tell the others!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, let's go do that!
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_2
